problem_statement: SIH26111 — Smart AI-Enabled Rapid Feed and Silage Quality Testing System

datasets.name: Research-Informed Synthetic Sensor Benchmark (2,400 Samples)
datasets.purpose: Group-aware Random Forest training, JSON tree serialization, and mobile TypeScript execution benchmarking
datasets.collection_method: Parametric generation using Gaussian/uniform distributions constrained by Kung et al. (2018)
datasets.data_circularity_warning: Ground-truth labels were generated using threshold rules on the generated features. ML models trained on this dataset learn this synthetic rule set. Benchmark performance does not equal real field performance.

datasets.name: Silage Surface Texture Synthetic Prototype (160 Images)
datasets.purpose: Vision pipeline verification, Albumentations augmentations, and MobileNetV3 TFLite export validation
datasets.collection_method: Procedural Pillow generation (geometric fiber lines and stippled fungal hyphae dots)
datasets.limitations: Does not capture outdoor agricultural conditions (glare, dust, shadow, chop length variation). Real field performance is not yet established.

datasets.name: Agronomic Literature Reference Benchmarks
datasets.purpose: Provides agronomic boundary intervals and peer-reviewed safety thresholds
citations: Kung et al. (2018), Journal of Dairy Science, 101(5), 4020-4033 (doi:10.3168/jds.2017-13909)
Borreani et al. (2018), Journal of Dairy Science, 101(5), 3952-3979 (doi:10.3168/jds.2017-13837)
datasets.note: These are meta-analysis papers providing reference values, not raw probe telemetry CSVs.

datasets.name: Vidarbha Dairy Belt Silage Pilot Observations
datasets.purpose: Standardized schema and preliminary on-farm pilot observations for field validation
datasets.missing_value_policy: Unmeasured parameters are recorded as null. Never fabricated.
datasets.small_dataset_support: Supports validation with cohorts of 20+, 50+, or 100+ real samples.
